selected_direction.name: Front Room
selected_direction.why: This direction makes the root feel curious, human, and worth exploring without turning it into a pitch deck.

design_thesis.one_liner: A mobile-first front room on the internet: a few high-signal objects, enough personality to keep clicking, and no overexplaining.
design_thesis.first_impression: Justin has taste, range, and a real life beyond a resume.

typography.display: Warm expressive serif for the name, likely continuing from the current Fraunces direction unless the prototype proves otherwise.
typography.body: System UI for readable route labels and short notes.
typography.labels: Plain nouns and action words; no decorative category language.
rules: No large marketing headline under the name.
Labels must fit on 390px mobile without wrapping awkwardly.

color_palette.name: living green
color_palette.usage: small route accents and focus states

shape: Soft object surfaces, but less uniformly card-like than the current template.
Touchable items remain comfortable and thumb-friendly.
Desktop can use shelf, table, or loose object placement.
texture: Subtle paper/object tactility is allowed if performance-safe.
No decorative blobs, orbs, or generic gradients.
imagery: Future photos or lifestyle objects require privacy review.
Objects should represent real routes or real public artifacts.
iconography: Icons should feel like objects, not app-store badges.
Do not rely on icons without readable labels.

experience_system.mobile_first: The first phone screen should show the name and immediate route objects, with a hint that more exists below.
layout: Group by proximity and spacing instead of visible category headings.
Keep the first three exits obvious.
Let desktop become more asymmetric without changing content.
interaction: Hover/focus can slightly move or wake objects.
No hidden navigation or hover-only meaning.
motion: Small Anime.js-style interaction may be prototyped only after static layout works.
No scroll spectacle or delayed route access.

content_modules.name: Proof routes
content_modules.purpose: Resume, docs, and GitHub for professional trust.

content_modules.name: Direct contact
content_modules.purpose: Schedule, Signal, and email without exposing private URLs.

content_modules.name: Selected objects
content_modules.purpose: Projects, photos, listening, or lifestyle artifacts after privacy review.

references.name: Paco Coursey
references.borrow: Plain personal signal density and route clarity.

references.name: Anime.js
references.borrow: Playful interaction as proof of craft, not decoration.

approval_checklist: Approved to generate an inactive preview template.
